rows.name: Tromsö Sund
rows.description: Leading lt. on S. Tonsnæs, N. entr. to Sund. (Sept. 1 to April 14). Not constantly attended

rows.name: Hekkingen
rows.description: Yellow wooden lt.-ho., 24 ft. high, N. side of Hekking Id., Malang Fiord. Lt. shown from N. by W. ¾ W., through East, to S.S.E. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Gi Sund
rows.description: Two at Finsnæs, E. side of S. entr., and two at Bukkeskind, E. shore of Sund. Lead betw. Leikness Islands and shoals to North and West. (Sept. 1 to April 14)

rows.name: ANDENÆS
rows.description: Red iron tower, 114 feet high. Flash every 3 minutes. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Tiel Sund
rows.description: Leading light on Græsholm, N. entr. to Sund. (Sept. 1 to April 14). Not constantly attended

rows.name: Lodingens Harbour
rows.description: On East side of Hjertholm. Visible between S.W. by S. ½ S. and N.E. by N. ½ N. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Stangholm
rows.description: Near Tranö-Vest Fiord. Vis. betw. E. ½ N. and W. ¾ S. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Kjeöen, South Point
rows.description: One fixed red light on Svolvær

rows.name: Lankvig
rows.description: One fixed bright light

rows.name: Orsvaag Harbour
rows.description: One fixed bright lt. on N.E. side of Sagoen Id.

rows.name: Sjaaholmen
rows.description: One fixed red light at Skraaven Harbour

rows.name: Fladö Islet
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt., br. flash. ev. ½ min.
rows.description: Gray lt.-ho., 42 ft. high, on S.W. hill, 6[?]0 yds. S.W. of beacon. Fixed light is red towards Grotö, between N.E. by N. ½ N. and N. ¾ E. Flash visible 20 miles

rows.name: Stamsund
rows.description: Tornholm, South point. Keep the light in sight, to avoid Stabben Rock

rows.name: HENNINGSVÆR
rows.description: Quitverden, in Salvorings Sound. Flash every 3 minutes. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Balstad
rows.description: Shown from Telegraph Station to S.E. betw. Tiestbo and Lejskjær

rows.name: Svinö
rows.description: One fixed red light near Balstad

rows.name: Grimsholmen
rows.description: One quick-flashing bright light

rows.name: Reine Harbour
rows.description: Fixed bright lt. on S. point of Olenilsoens Id.

rows.name: Klopen or Gloppen
rows.description: Lt.-ho., 24 ft. high, at Sörvaagen, South of entrance. Lt. shown from W.S.W., through South, to N.E. ¾ N., except where obscured by land between W.S.W. and S.W. ½ W. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Vœrö
rows.description: White lt.-ho., 36 ft. high, on E. side of Röstnœsvaagen. Lt. shown from N.E. ¼ E. to W. ¾ S.

rows.name: Röst Island
rows.description: Fixed bright lt. at Vœrholmnakken; a fixed bright and red lt. at Bratskjœr, and another at Halklakken. Not constantly attended

rows.name: Grötösund
rows.description: Leading lts. at North entrance, 400 yds. apart. (Sept. 1 to April 14). Not constantly attended

rows.name: Vaagö, or N. Hellig Vær.
rows.description: One fixed red light on N.E. point of island

rows.name: Grytö, or S. Hellig Vær.
rows.description: One fixed bright light on S.E. point

rows.name: Nyholm Island
rows.character: One fixed bright or red light
rows.description: Stone tower on E. point of Id. Lt. shown from Aug. 15 to Apl. 30. In W. channel, br. betw. S.W. by W. ¾ W. and W. ½ N.; red thence to W. ¾ S. In N. channel, br. from N. by E. ¾ E. to N.E. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: STÖT
rows.character: One fixed and flashing bright light, 2 min.
rows.description: Tower on centre Seskiær; guide to harb. from the North. Red betw. N.E. by N. ½ N. and E. by N. ¾ N., over Stötkuv & Rörbö. Flash every 2 minutes. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: TRAE ISLANDS
rows.description: Red iron lt.-ho., 90 ft. high, on Söe Id. A flash of 12 secs. in every min. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: ANDERSBAK ISLAND
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: White stone lt.-ho., 32 ft. high, on N.E. island of Aas Vœr group. Lt. shows bright betw. W. by N. ¼ N. and N.E. ½ N., through N.; red thence to E. by S. ¾ S., through East; bright thence to S.E. by S. ½ S. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Vivelstad
rows.description: E. side of sound. Vis. to northwd. & southwd.; in N. inlet obscured E. of line passing 1 cable W. of Snertholmtarren. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Brönösund
rows.description: On North side of Buholmen, at North entrance. (Aug. 15 to April 30)

rows.name: Somnæs Harbour
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: On Jernholmen, N. side of entr. Red to W. and N.W., br. towards harbour. Obscured in N. part of Torg Fiord. (Aug. 15 to April 30)
